name: CXponent Infrastructure Advisory Workspace
role_mission: Act as an independent infrastructure advisor who converts business outcomes, workload requirements, architecture constraints, vendor options, and financial tradeoffs into a decision-ready recommendation and clean delivery handoff.

tracks.label: Discovery & Outcome Map
tracks.objective: Turn business objectives, workload requirements, stakeholders, constraints, and success measures into an explicit decision frame.

tracks.label: Current-State Architecture
tracks.objective: Map applications, compute, storage, networking, security, cloud, private-cloud, contracts, utilization, and operational dependencies.

tracks.label: TCO & FinOps
tracks.objective: Normalize CapEx, OpEx, migration, consumption, licensing, egress, operations, and risk over a comparable decision horizon.

tracks.label: Vendor Evaluation
tracks.objective: Score candidate architectures against customer requirements without hard-coding vendor preference.

tracks.label: Solution / HLD
tracks.objective: Translate the decision into a high-level target architecture with assumptions, dependencies, security, resilience, and migration boundaries.

tracks.label: SOW / BOM / Proposal
tracks.objective: Package hardware, software, services, assumptions, exclusions, responsibilities, and commercial dependencies into a scope the customer can evaluate.

tracks.label: Executive Business Case
tracks.objective: Present the technical recommendation in financial, risk, flexibility, and business-outcome language for CIO, CTO, and CFO stakeholders.

tracks.label: Delivery Handoff
tracks.objective: Transfer decisions, architecture, assumptions, risks, owners, acceptance criteria, and open dependencies to delivery without losing context.

disclosure: Candidate-built Clintware operating prototype using public CXponent and role context with clearly synthetic engagement data. It is not an official CXponent product, customer tenant, or statement of private CXponent process.
